$comment: Custody X-1 step 1, W2 (bypass 3). Every env var NAME the boot path and the role-secret consumers read, in exactly one class. Names only, never values. Checked by scripts/ci/env-secret-inventory.js --check; read by tests/security/env-secret-inventory.node-test.js. The entrypoint's _AB_ROLE_ENV_VARS list must equal the ROLE set (NAME:role).

AGENTBOX_AGENT_PRIVKEY_HEX.reason: Per-agent DID key override (agent-identity.js loadOrMint); the keyring id is the profile.

AGENTBOX_BRIDGE_SK.reason: The same sovereign key as hex, written to identity.env for the relay daemon. Already moved to /run/secrets/nostr.key and unset before supervisord (SEC-003); kept here so the scrub and the loaders treat it like the others.

AGENTBOX_NSEC.reason: The same sovereign key, bech32. Operator pin read by the bootstrap; identity.env exported it to PID 1 (bootstrap.rs render_runtime_env) and git-bridge signs with it.

AGENTBOX_PRIVKEY_HEX.reason: Operator pin of the sovereign key (64-hex); wins over the identity file (identity.rs ensure_identity). Read by the bootstrap, the live-mirror hook, the nostr-gateway and nostr-send.

AGENT_PRIVKEY_HEX.reason: Per-user agent key handed to scripts/run-per-user-agent.cjs.

CONCIERGE_PRIVKEY_HEX.reason: Legacy alias of the JunkieJarvis key (junkiejarvis-agent.js, dream-forum-suggestions, run-per-user-agent).

JUNKIEJARVIS_PRIVKEY_HEX.reason: JunkieJarvis forum agent key (keyring id junkiejarvis): management-api JJ agent, dream-engine governance and digest, dream-forum-suggestions, run-junkiejarvis, run-per-user-agent fallback.

NIP98_PROXY_ALLOW_BEARER.reason: The LAN-door break-glass bearer at the nip98-proxy (ADR-2027). W1 delivers it to ab-ingress (config/role-accounts.json). 2026-10-03: it is still the SAME VALUE as BRIDGE_TOKEN (management-api/lib/system-manifest.js:79), which stays devuser-class, so isolating this copy protects nothing until the Q4 split mints a separate bearer.

NIP98_PROXY_SESSION_SECRET.reason: NIP-07 session-cookie HMAC secret of the nip98-proxy; W1 delivers it to ab-ingress (design §2.4).

OPERATOR_NOSTR_PRIVKEY.reason: Operator key fallback for the live mirror, the nostr-gateway and nostr-send.

TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY.reason: Tailnet join key. Its only reader is the root tailscale-up program, which passed it on argv; under the flag it gets the key as --authkey=file:<path>.

NON_SECRET.$comment: Paths, ports, switches, model names, public keys, shell locals. Secret-shaped names must be listed exactly; no pattern may classify one.

role_files.$comment: ROLE secrets that already reach their reader by FILE, with only a path in the environment. Nothing to scrub; W1 moves the files to their role's ownership.
role_files.pay402 spend keys: AGENTBOX_AGENT_IDENTITY_DIR (path; agent-spend-<chain>-<did>.key); Q6 defers their role

w1_plan.$comment: Parity with W1's delivery table (config/role-accounts.json, ADR-2122). Every from_env there is ROLE here with the same role (checked). ROLE vars W1's plan does not carry are delivered only by the W2 capture and listed here, so drift either way fails the inventory.
